Man Dies After Airbag Deploys in Stationary Car in Mira Road

A 25-year-old man died in Mira Road after an airbag in a stationary car unexpectedly deployed. The incident occurred while the man, identified as a car dealer, was inspecting a second-hand vehicle. The airbag cover reportedly struck his neck, causing severe injury and significant blood loss. Police are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the death.
